title: .qwencloud-deploy state file
description: Deployment state written by qwencloud-deploy. Reused during deletion / redeployment / hot update.

deploy_mode.description: Deployment mode: full-stack = ROS full-stack orchestration

frontend_dir.description: Local frontend build artifact directory (relative to project root), null when no frontend

backend_dir.description: Local backend directory or artifact directory

db_instance_id.description: RDS instance ID (present when RDS is included in deployment)

nginx_mode.description: Nginx hosting mode: static-proxy (static hosting + reverse proxy), proxy (full reverse proxy), static (pure static)

artifact_bucket.description: Temporary OSS bucket used by this deployment (cleaned up together when deleting the stack)

db_engine.description: If RDS was provisioned with the deployment, records the engine type. Only MySQL is supported.

domain.description: Custom domain bound to this deployment (e.g. app.example.com). null if no domain configured.

https.description: HTTPS/SSL certificate state. null if HTTPS not configured.

email.description: Email used for Let's Encrypt registration

cert_path.description: Path to fullchain.pem on ECS (nginx mode)

key_path.description: Path to privkey.pem on ECS (nginx mode)

cert_manager_instance_id.description: ECS instance ID that manages certbot. Used for renewal.

auto_renew.description: Whether auto-renewal is configured (certbot cron on ECS)

registrant_profile_id.description: Alibaba Cloud domain registrant profile ID (reused across deployments). null if no domain purchased.

provisional.description: true indicates this is a temporary state written by create_stack.sh immediately after obtaining the StackId (contains only stack_id / stack_name / region_id locator fields, may lack topology / app_type / outputs). Used so that delete_stack.sh can still clean up after interruption; record_state.py will overwrite with the complete state and remove this field upon success.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent hot update (written by update_app.sh). null after initial deployment.
